messages:
Irene (security-docs): small PR to tighten SOC2 audit-log language and add a short SDK example for export redaction + legal hold. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7066

Ana (Docs): can you confirm: default retention and who can request extended retention? want to avoid implied commitments.

Irene (security-docs): default = 90 days. Extended retention only via contract or authorized request (account owner, designated legal contact, or authorized compliance admin). Legal holds persist until removed and override TTL. No change to SLA.

Omar (eng): adding a tiny Python snippet for the export API that we can include in the PR:
```python
# export + redaction + legal hold
client = RedwoodClient(api_key)
resp = client.exports.create({
  'tenant_id':'acct-42',
  'start_time':'2024-05-01T00:00:00Z',
  'end_time':'2024-05-31T23:59:59Z',
  'redact_fields':['user_email'],
  'apply_legal_hold':True
})
print(resp['id'])
```

link-bot: link-check: found /compliance/audit -> replace with /security/compliance/retention

Liam (Legal): language nits: use neutral phrasing like "Default retention is 90 days" or "Redwood retains..." Replace any "we will" text. Add a short note that contractual terms supersede docs.

Ana (Docs): will update wording and swap the link. Also add one-line operational note: TTL enforcement job runs hourly; legal_hold is effective immediately.

Irene (security-docs): perfect. After Ana pushes edits I'll request sign-off from Legal and then merge.

Omar (eng): FYI for private deployments: redaction in exports is only automatic for managed exports; added a short caveat to the draft.

Liam (Legal): OK with that. No legal blockers for wording changes.

Ana (Docs): updating now, will ping when pushed.
